# Japan 365 Days

> > A comprehensive Japan travel guide based on 20 years of personal exploration, covering traditional ryokans, onsen hot springs, and destinations across Tokyo, Kyoto, Hakone, Miyajima, and regional prefectures.

This site provides detailed travel guidance for Japan's most iconic destinations, with specialized focus on traditional accommodations (ryokans) and regional prefecture guides. The content draws from two decades of firsthand travel experience exploring Japan's cultural landmarks, natural wonders, and hospitality traditions.

## Key Topics

- Ryokans (traditional Japanese inns)
- Onsen (hot springs)
- Tokyo attractions and accommodations
- Kyoto cultural sites
- Hakone mountain resort area
- Miyajima and Itsukushima Shrine
- Nikko temples and nature
- Himeji Castle (Hyogo Prefecture)
- Todai-ji Temple (Nara)
- Japanese regional prefectures
- Traditional Japanese lodging
- Japan UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Hiroshima and surrounding areas
- Mount Fuji region
- Japanese cultural experiences

- [Japan Travel Guide - Based on 20 Years of Exploring Japan](https://www.japan365days.com): Homepage for Japan travel guide covering Tokyo, Kyoto, Mt. Fuji & more

## Traditional Ryokans & Onsen Accommodations

- [Overview Best Ryokans in Japan - Traditional Inns & Onsen](https://www.japan365days.com/best_ryokans.php): Overview of Japan's best ryokans in Kyoto, Kobe, Nara & Ise regions
- [Best Ryokans in Tokyo Top 10 - Traditional Inns & Onsen](https://www.japan365days.com/best_ryokans_in_tokyo.php): Top 10 Tokyo ryokans in Asakusa near Tokyo Skytree & Ueno Park
- [Best Ryokans in Hakone Top 10 - Traditional Inns & Onsen](https://www.japan365days.com/best_ryokans_in_hakone.php): Top 10 Hakone ryokans guide featuring Mikawaya & Fukuzumiro
- [Best Ryokans in Miyajima Top 10 - Miyajima Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/best_ryokans_in_miyajima.php): Top 10 Miyajima ryokans including Iwaso in Momijidani, Hiroshima
- [Best Ryokans in Nikko - Traditional Inns & Onsen](https://www.japan365days.com/best_ryokans_in_nikko.php): Nikko ryokan guide featuring Hoshinoyado & Kinugawa Onsen inns

## Regional Prefecture Guides

- [Hyogo Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_hyogo_lp.php): Hyogo Prefecture guide featuring Himeji Castle, Kobe & Engyo-ji
- [Hokkaido Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_hokkaido_lp.php): Hokkaido guide to Lake Mashu, Shiretoko Peninsula & attractions
- [Kumamoto Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_kumamoto_lp.php): Kumamoto Prefecture guide to Mount Aso & Kumamoto Castle
- [Wakayama Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_wakayama_lp.php): Wakayama guide to Nachi Falls, Mount Koya & Doro-kyo Gorge
- [Shimane Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_shimane_lp.php): Shimane guide featuring Iwami Ginzan Silver Mine & Matsue Castle
- [Yamaguchi Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_yamaguchi_lp.php): Yamaguchi Prefecture guide to Brocade Sash Bridge & Iwakuni Castle
- [Aomori Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_aomori_lp.php): Aomori Prefecture guide covering Towada-ko & Hakkoda Mountains
- [Chiba Prefecture - Japan Travel Guide](https://www.japan365days.com/japan_travel_chiba_lp.php): Chiba Prefecture guide featuring Mt. Nokogiri & accommodations
